metadata.title: Understanding Students’ Subjective and Eudaimonic Well‑Being: Combining both Machine Learning and Classical Statistics

design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values are not applicable because the dependent variables are well-being constructs rather than PISA cognitive achievement scores.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Recorded evidence does not explicitly establish an unweighted analysis. Original extraction rationale: The study uses student-level ILSA microdata but does not mention applying any sampling weights in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study used hierarchical linear modeling to account for the nested structure of the data, which indicates consideration of school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions internal validation methods such as tenfold cross-validation, which disqualifies it from having external validation.
